The default value is medium, which is a balance between speed and reasoning accuracy.

model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.
model_parameters.label: Top P

model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.
model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
model_parameters.label: Logit Bias

model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.
model_parameters.label: Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.
model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.
model_parameters.label: Number of Responses

model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.
model_parameters.label: Seed

model_parameters.helpText: Controls how much the AI should exaggerate the style of the voice. Higher values result in more expressive and dramatic speech.

model_parameters.helpText: Boost the similarity to the speaker and reduces differences between speakers. Useful when using different voices in the same audio.

rules.description: Claude opus/sonnet/haiku at version 4.6 or higher: 4.6 through 4.99, then any 5.x, 6.x or later major. The minor is capped at two digits so an 8-digit date suffix such as claude-opus-4-20250514 is never read as a >= 4.6 minor. Turns on adaptive thinking for new families with no code change.
rules.name: anthropic-claude-adaptive-thinking

rules.description: Any Claude family-major-minor id, optionally with an 8-digit date suffix, anchored to the whole name. Version-neutral fallback that gives an unmapped Claude provider routing and baseline capabilities; it carries no pricing, so cost stays on the standard unpriced behavior rather than a guessed number.
rules.name: anthropic-claude

model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.
model_parameters.label: Stop

model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.
model_parameters.label: Top P

model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.
model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
model_parameters.label: Logit Bias

model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.
model_parameters.label: Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.
model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.
model_parameters.label: Number of Responses

model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.
model_parameters.label: Seed

model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.
model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
model_parameters.label: Logit Bias

model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.
model_parameters.label: Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.
model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.
model_parameters.label: Number of Responses

model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.
model_parameters.label: Seed

model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.
model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
model_parameters.label: Logit Bias

model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.
model_parameters.label: Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.
model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.
model_parameters.label: Number of Responses

model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.
model_parameters.label: Seed

model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.
model_parameters.label: Stream

model_parameters.helpText: Controls search mode: 'academic' prioritizes scholarly sources, 'sec' prioritizes SEC filings, 'web' uses general web search.
model_parameters.label: Search Mode

model_parameters.helpText: A comma-separated list of domains to limit search results to. Add a '-' at the beginning of a domain to exclude it. Limited to 20 domains.
model_parameters.label: Search Domain Filter

model_parameters.helpText: Determines whether search results should include images.
model_parameters.label: Return Images

model_parameters.helpText: Determines whether search results should include videos.
model_parameters.label: Return Videos

model_parameters.helpText: Determines whether related questions should be returned.
model_parameters.label: Return Related Questions

model_parameters.helpText: Filters search results based on time (e.g., 'week', 'day').
model_parameters.label: Search Recency Filter

model_parameters.helpText: Filters search results to only include content published after this date. Format: MM/DD/YYYY (e.g., 3/1/2025).
model_parameters.label: Search After Date Filter

model_parameters.helpText: Filters search results to only include content published before this date. Format: MM/DD/YYYY (e.g., 3/1/2025).
model_parameters.label: Search Before Date Filter

model_parameters.helpText: Filters search results to only include content last updated after this date. Format: MM/DD/YYYY (e.g., 3/1/2025).
model_parameters.label: Last Updated After Filter

model_parameters.helpText: Filters search results to only include content last updated before this date. Format: MM/DD/YYYY (e.g., 3/1/2025).
model_parameters.label: Last Updated Before Filter

model_parameters.helpText: The number of tokens to keep for top-k filtering. Limits the model to consider only the k most likely next tokens at each step. A value of 0 disables this filter.
model_parameters.label: Top K

model_parameters.helpText: When set to true, disables web search completely and the model will only use its training data to respond.
model_parameters.label: Disable Search

model_parameters.helpText: Enables a classifier that decides if web search is needed based on your query.
model_parameters.label: Enable Search Classifier

model_parameters.helpText: Controls the size of search context used in web search. Options: low, medium, high.
model_parameters.label: Search Context Size

model_parameters.helpText: A list of tools the model may call.
model_parameters.label: Prompt Tools (Functions)

model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.
model_parameters.label: Temperature

model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.
model_parameters.label: Max Tokens

model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.
model_parameters.label: Stop

model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.
model_parameters.label: Top P

model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.
model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
model_parameters.label: Logit Bias

model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.
model_parameters.label: Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.
model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.
model_parameters.label: Number of Responses

model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.
model_parameters.label: Seed

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.
model_parameters.label: Stop

model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.
model_parameters.label: Top P

model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.
model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
model_parameters.label: Logit Bias

model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.
model_parameters.label: Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.
model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.
model_parameters.label: Stop

model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.
model_parameters.label: Top P

model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.
model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
model_parameters.label: Logit Bias

model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.
model_parameters.label: Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.
model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.
model_parameters.label: Logit Bias

model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.
model_parameters.label: Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.
model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.
model_parameters.label: Number of Responses

model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.
model_parameters.label: Seed

model_parameters.helpText: The top_k parameter is used to limit the number of choices for the next predicted word or token. It specifies the maximum number of tokens to consider at each step, based on their probability of occurrence. This technique helps to speed up the generation process and can improve the quality of the generated text by focusing on the most likely options.
model_parameters.label: Top K

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty

model_parameters.helpText: Reasoning effort is used to give the model guidance on how many reasoning tokens it should generate before creating a response to the prompt. You can specify one of low, medium, or high for this parameter, where low will favor speed and economical token usage, and high will favor more complete reasoning at the cost of more tokens generated and slower responses. The default value is medium, which is a balance between speed and reasoning accuracy.
model_parameters.label: Reasoning Effort
